description.zh: 刘倍延 — 研究策略交互、智能体以及它们共享的系统。
description.en: Beiyan Liu — research on strategic interaction, intelligent agents, and the systems they share.

intro.zh: 我是刘倍延，毕业于中山大学软件工程专业。我的研究关注有自身利益诉求的参与者如何共享资源、作出决策，并找到合作的方式。
intro.en: I’m Beiyan, a software engineering graduate from Sun Yat-sen University. My research has explored how self-interested participants share resources, make decisions, and find ways to cooperate.

current.zh: 我学习、做东西、写东西，也享受其中的乐趣。
current.en: I learn stuff, build stuff, write stuff, and have fun along the way.
